_comment: SAMPLE reference catalog for DLPaC. The sensitiveInfoTypes GUIDs below are Microsoft's GLOBAL built-in identifiers (identical in every tenant, published in Microsoft docs) and are safe to ship. Values that are tenant-specific — groups, sensitivityLabels, sites, and custom SITs — are PLACEHOLDERS: replace them with your own via powershell/Update-Catalog.ps1. The compiler resolves friendly names to these values and fails closed on anything unknown.
